summary: Elva provides payment controls for Harbour Bank's launch of stablecoin-powered cross-border payouts to SMEs, using NUSD on Ethereum and Polygon. Go-live depends on Harbour Bank providing sandbox and testnet access by 10 November.
deliverables: Payout ledger connector, up to 12,000 payouts a day at launch
NUSD wallet screening: Ethereum in real time; Polygon in hourly batches
Weekly project status meeting during implementation
